ttl.name: Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly LH (FF)

s2.ptxt: Remove the parking brake lever protector from the parking brake cable assembly No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.3

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the cable end from the operating lever of the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.
Using an offset wrench (14mm), disconnect parking brake cable assembly No.3 from the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.

atten4.ptxt: Insert the offset wrench all the way into the clip as shown in the illustration, flex the clip, and pull parking brake cable assembly No.3 out of the guide of the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and separate the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.

atten3.ptxt: Suspend the caliper with wire or equivalent.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and remove the disc.
Disconnect the connector from the skid control sensor.

atten3.ptxt: Do not twist the skid control sensor wire.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and remove the rear axle hub & bearing assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.
